title: feat: add the pollinations-large sandbox template (4 vCPU, 8 GB)
author: voodoohop

gist.summary: Added an opt-in `pollinations-large` sandbox template, created with `polli sandbox create pollinations-large`, with 4 vCPU and 8 GB RAM. The default `pollinations` template remains 2 vCPU and 2 GB; the larger option gives memory-heavy workloads, including the full gen test suite, room beyond the default sandbox's 2 GB limit. Both templates use the same Dockerfile image, with the large template built using `--cpu-count 4 --memory-mb 8192`. Gen logs polli in for both templates by exact template name, and billing follows each sandbox's actual size. Docs list launch prices of about 0.033 Pollen/hour for `pollinations` and 0.083 Pollen/hour for `pollinations-large`. CLI help, README, and skill documentation name the new template; `@pollinations/cli` was bumped to 0.1.41.

image.prompt: In a cozy pixel art garden shed, Polli stands beside two flower-framed sandbox workbenches, gently helping the larger one grow enough room for a stack of test files; a lime green (#ecf874) terminal glows nearby. The main character is a cute pixel art bee mascot with a yellow body and dark brown horizontal stripes, small black legs, two black antennae, black vertical oval eyes, bright pink rectangular blush marks on cheeks, a small happy smile, and small rounded light blue translucent wings; she wears a tiny tool belt, is small-to-medium sized and never dominates the scene, and is strictly pixel art, never realistic. Cozy pixel art, 8-bit aesthetic, chunky retro sprites, soft pastel gradients, warm lighting, retro gaming vibes, with warm cream and mint-to-peach accents and dark purple (#110518) outlines; nostalgic but beautiful, emotionally warm.
